title: Avocado Toast with Poached Eggs
description: Creamy smashed avocado on sourdough toast topped with perfectly poached eggs, chili flakes, and microgreens. The ultimate brunch staple.
instructions: Toast sourdough slices until golden and crispy.
Halve avocados, remove pits, and scoop flesh into a bowl. Add lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Mash to desired consistency.
Bring a wide shallow pot of water to a gentle simmer. Add white wine vinegar.
Crack each egg into a small cup. Create a gentle whirlpool in the water and slide eggs in. Cook 3 minutes for runny yolks.
Spread mashed avocado generously over each toast slice.
Place poached eggs on top. Drizzle with olive oil.
Garnish with chili flakes, microgreens, and flaky sea salt.
author: Chef Sofia
